metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds the hill, Errors, and the reckoning.

yesterday: Tomorrow is Candlemas. The letter is not written yet, and nothing is set beside the horn.
You do not yet know the day you will tell Anne.

Next week, as John read it: Monday Titus, you. Tuesday rehearsal at nine, and Fair Em, you. Wednesday Titus, not you. Thursday rehearsal at nine, and the Seven Deadly Sins, you. Friday Fair Em, not you. Saturday the Seven Deadly Sins, you.
John set next week. The gown is still at the mercer's.
